description: This source file defines the enum ExecAllowlistMatcher, which provides methods to match executable paths against patterns in an allowlist, for security or validation purposes.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a given command resolution against a list of allowlist entries, returning the first matching entry if any.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Returns all allowlist entries that match a list of command resolutions.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if a target string matches a given pattern, considering wildcards and tilde expansion.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a path string by replacing backslashes with slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Constructs a regular expression from a wildcard pattern, supporting `*`, `**`, and `?`.
